title.narrative: Mobilizing international climate finance and private investments for low-carbon development in Peru

description.narrative: The Government of Peru has developed adequate capacity, strategic frameworks, and a pipeline to accelerate the mobilization of national and international climate finance while promoting private sector participation and investments in climate change mitigation and adaptation, through private and public financial sector actors’ enhanced sustainable finance capacity, plans, and instruments.The proposed Readiness grant plays a pivotal role in the implementation of the country’s Climate Finance Strategy (CFS) and Green Finance Roadmap (GFR) which outline strategic measures and actions to accelerate the flow of international climate finance and private sector investments towards lowcarbon, resilient projects and initiatives.

The proposed Readiness grant aims to enhance the institutional capacity, strategic frameworks, and project pipeline of the Government ofPeru to increase the mobilization of climate finance and private investments for NDC implementation and low carbon development.
